components.name: Node.js 20 server (server.mjs)

cost.basis: Runs inside the michigansalt Render service.

components.notes: Plain Node http server, not Express. Serves pages plus APIs: /api/quote (price quote), /api/lead (quote/abandon events), /api/request (real order request), /health. Prices and origin are kept server-side in JSON, never sent to the browser. Env var names: LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL, LEAD_WEBHOOK_SECRET, PORT.

cost.basis: Free public demo server.

components.name: Lead files on site server (leads/*.json)

cost.basis: Part of the michigansalt service.

components.notes: Each quote, abandon, and request is written to a JSON file and an inbox log on the site server, then forwarded to ops. No disk is attached, so these files are probably wiped on each deploy (unconfirmed). Ops is the lasting copy.

components.name: Ops board app (Express + SQLite)

cost.basis: Runs inside the michigansalt-ops Render service.

components.notes: Receives the lead webhook (POST /webhooks/leads with a shared secret), saves the order, and shows Nick a Kanban: lead > quoted > invoiced > awaiting pay > paid > scheduled > delivered. Admin pages need a token. Has an ops-only finance strip. Env var names: WEBHOOK_SECRET, ADMIN_TOKEN, RESEND_API_KEY, ALERT_FROM, ALERT_TO, DATABASE_PATH.

michigan-salt.title: Visit
michigan-salt.detail: Customer opens michigansalt.com. Porkbun DNS points to Render, Render's CDN serves the static pages, and GoatCounter counts the visit.

michigan-salt.title: Quote
michigan-salt.detail: Customer enters address, sack count, and forks. The server turns the ZIP into a map point, gets driving miles from OSRM, and returns one all-in delivered price.

michigan-salt.title: Request
michigan-salt.detail: Request this load. The site saves the lead and forwards it with a shared secret to the ops board, which saves it in SQLite.

michigan-salt.title: Alert
michigan-salt.detail: Ops emails an order alert through Resend to the hudsonville@ inbox (watched by Mr. McFeely).

michigan-salt.title: Invoice
michigan-salt.detail: An invoice is created in QuickBooks Online through Zapier and emailed to the customer. Nick approves.

michigan-salt.title: Pay
michigan-salt.detail: Customer pays by QBO pay page, ACH, check, or wire. No card payments on the site.

michigan-salt.title: Ship
michigan-salt.detail: Mr. Krabs confirms cleared funds, then the truck is scheduled. The ops board moves the order to paid, scheduled, and delivered.
